docs: 2026-10-11 agenda — #483 testing + discoverability as explicit items (#500)

* docs: conversion excess-grams money rule design (1oz curve)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018YsWJrQfoosxCnWoPH9xNQ

* Conversions: allow excess grams (1oz) — excess valued at spot against the fee

Implements docs/conversion-excess-grams-design.md (approved 2026-10-10).

- Pure rule computeExcessSettlement: pieces may exceed the bar grams; the
  excess is valued at submission spot, set against the fee, and any balance
  is a payout owed after approval. Minimum stays 50g; a minimal-set guard
  refuses padding (excess must be smaller than the smallest piece).
- Selection tops off with one odd-weight piece; whole-gram pools unchanged.
- Preview/form/spec/web show extra gold, fee credit and payout; a S$0 fee
  skips HitPay and creates the conversion directly (shared
  createConversionFromPayload). Older iOS builds get a 426 asking to update;
  SDUIPlaceConversionButton handles the S$0 response (rides iOS 1.0.10).
- Migration 20261010b: received/excess/credit/payout columns + payout record.
- Admin: payout due + record payout (CAS, approved-or-later, not rejected).
- Books: cost of conversion gains V − e·sa; balance sheet carries the credit
  as a receivable before approval and the payout as a payable until paid.
- SDUI contract §194.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018YsWJrQfoosxCnWoPH9xNQ

* Conversions: make record-payout eligibility part of the atomic write

The record-payout UPDATE guarded only payout_paid_at, so a reject (or status
change) landing between the eligibility read and the write could still record
a payout. The filter now also requires rejected_at IS NULL and an eligible
status, so the check and the write cannot disagree. Security-agent finding
1d994328 (low). Admin-only; no iOS impact; no migration.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018YsWJrQfoosxCnWoPH9xNQ
